info.name: USDA AMS MARS API (MyMarketNews) Offices Reports API

params.name: q
params.description: Search query to filter reports by name or description.

params.name: dateType
params.description: Date type to filter by (published, report).

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date for filtering reports (YYYY-MM-DD). Maximum 180 days from startDate.

params.name: slug_id
params.description: Filter by specific report slug ID.

params.name: class
params.description: Filter by commodity class (e.g., Livestock, Dairy, Fruit/Veg).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return (max 100000).

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

items.docs: Returns a list of all available market news reports. Each report has a unique Slug_ID and Slug_Name that serve as identifiers. Reports cover livestock, dairy, fruits, vegetables, grains, cotton, tobacco, poultry, and other agricultural commodities.

params.name: slug_id
params.description: Unique identifier (Slug_ID) for the market news report.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date for filtering data within the report (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date for filtering data (YYYY-MM-DD). Maximum 180 days from startDate.

items.docs: Returns market news data for a specific report identified by its unique slug_id. Returns the full report data including commodity prices, volumes, and trade information.
